## Problem / 问题

What concrete Prompt quality or reliability problem does this change address?  
本次变更解决了什么具体的 Prompt 质量或可靠性问题？

## Evidence / 证据

Link the fixture, failure trace, issue, or reproducible example.  
请附上 fixture、失败记录、Issue 或可复现案例。

## Change / 变更

Describe behavior changes and compatibility impact.  
请说明行为变化及兼容性影响。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] Skill validation passes / Skill 验证通过
- [ ] Markdown links and JSONL are valid / Markdown 链接和 JSONL 有效
- [ ] Rule changes include a fixture / 规则变更包含 fixture
- [ ] Static claims are separated from executed results / 静态声明与运行结果已分离
- [ ] No private or unlicensed data is included / 不包含私密或未授权数据
